claim: Potential of mean force (PMF) quantities in protein structure prediction are approximations of statistically rigorous quantities that arise when probability distributions over different features of proteins need to be combined.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by deriving PMF expressions from combined probability distributions and comparing them to standard PMF formulations used in protein structure prediction.

conditions: When probability distributions over different features of proteins are combined
exclusions: Limited to the formal derivation presented; transfer to other probabilistic frameworks requires verification

title: Potential of mean force–Emergence of PMF quantities theorem
